title: Zero-G 6DOF Drift, Anchoring, and Comfort
description:
Purpose: Provide free 6DOF navigation in ruptured station segments and space with gentle stabilization, grip-to-anchor, and comfort options.

Behaviour:
- Enable in derelict_station scenes/volumes tagged CTag{"zero_g"}.
- Controls:
  - Left Thumbstick: thrust in HMD forward/strafe (or controller relative if selected) with small accel; damping provides gentle drift feel.
  - Right Thumbstick: orientation assist (yaw/pitch/roll). Snap-roll is disabled by default; can be enabled via settings but remains off for this title per constraints.
  - Grip (either): when near a surface, anchor to it (zero velocity, align to surface normal), allowing careful work (e.g., placing barriers).
- Comfort:
  - Increase vignette during spins or high angular velocity; expose params.value("vignette_spin_scale", 0.6).
  - Orientation cues: enable ring HUD horizon line and guide markers.

Quest 3 bindings (params_json):
- params.value("grip_anchor", true)

Components read/write:
- Reads CMechanicBinding, CTransform, CPhysics, zero-G volume tags; writes CZeroGState{ active:bool }, orientation assists.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_derelict_zero_g: Navigate zero-G, anchor with Grip, seal a breach with barrier.

Assets/scenes: derelict_station.
